reference.title: Admin API reference
reference.shortdesc: Every route of the admin API: docs repositories, builds, organizations, readers, the audit log and docs analytics.

section.title: Basics

ul.li: Base path /admin/api, JSON in and out.
Every request needs Authorization: Bearer $OPEND_ADMIN_TOKEN. A missing or wrong token gets 401 {"error":"unauthorized"}. The token is compared in constant time.
Without OPEND_ADMIN_TOKEN, none of these routes exist.
An invalid body gets 400 {"error":"invalid request","issues":[...]}, one issue per problem.
Every change is written to the audit log with the actor admin-token.

section.p: Staff readers can do most of this in the browser instead, in the admin console at /admin; see . Its changes are audited with the actor staff:email.

strow.stentry: Lists registered repositories: id, fullName, sourceUrl, installationId, releaseRefs, docsPath, access and publicEntitlements.
Registers a repository, or replaces the settings of the one with the same fullName. 201 with the repository.

Makes the repository's site private or public. Body {"access": "public", "publicEntitlements": {"products": [], "features": [], "version": "2.1"}}. Leaving out publicEntitlements keeps the current set; null clears it. Every cached page is dropped at once, on every replica. 200 with the repository; 404 {"error":"no such repo"}. See .
The live release for each release line: releaseId, releaseLine, release, sha.

Takes a release line off the site, for example one left over from a test build. Readers of that line see that nothing is published, and the staff view and the API fall back to the next newest line. The stored release is kept, and the next successful build for the line puts it back.

Everything about the site that is not rebuilt from Git, as one JSON document for moving it to another deployment: the repository, orgs, entitlements, readers, staff, editor accounts and working branches, settings, sealed secrets, API key hashes and the audit log. Releases, builds, search indexes and analytics are left out. Treat the file as a secret.

Loads an export into a site that has none of that data yet (409 otherwise). Rows keep their ids. Sealed secrets only open if this deployment uses the same OPEND_SECRET_KEY (or SESSION_SECRET) as the one exported from. Then request builds, or let the poller run, to publish releases.

property.propdesc: owner/name, as GitHub sends it in webhooks. Matched without regard to case.

The URL the worker fetches from, such as https://github.com/acme/docs.git. Must be an https:// URL; when NODE_ENV is not production, an absolute local path or a file: URL is also accepted. The installation token is only sent to github.com, or to the host that GITHUB_API_URL names.
The GitHub App installation id: a positive integer, or null.
Branch and tag names that publish. Not empty. * matches any run of characters.
The folder holding opend.config.yaml, inside the repository: no leading / and no ...

refbody.p: Omitted fields are reset to their defaults when a repository is registered again. The access mode is not one of them: only PUT /admin/api/repos/:id/access (or a seed file) changes it.

strow.stentry: Queues a build of one commit. Body {"ref": "main", "sha": "<40 hex characters>"}. 202 with the job; 404 {"error":"no such repo"}.
Recent builds, newest first. Query repoId to filter, and limit (default 50, at most 200).
One build, with its diagnostics. 404 {"error":"no such build"}.

refbody.p: A build has id, repoId, ref, sha, status (queued, running, succeeded or failed), attempts, error, diagnostics, releaseId, createdAt and finishedAt. Each diagnostic has the severity, code, message, file, line and column described in .

strow.stentry: Lists organizations with their products, features and version (null without entitlements).
Creates or renames an organization. Body {"slug", "name", "entitlements"?}. 201 {"slug"}.
Replaces the entitlements. Body {"products": [], "features": [], "version": "0.1"}. 200 with the result; 404 {"error":"no such org"}.
Deletes the organization, its entitlements and its readers. 204; 404 if there is no such organization.

refbody.p: A slug is 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or digit. products and features default to empty lists and hold tokens; version is required and looks like 0.1, with an optional leading v.

strow.stentry: Lists readers: id, orgId, orgSlug, email, name, staff, and the linked oidcIssuer and oidcSubject.
Adds a reader, or moves an existing email to another organization. Body {"orgSlug", "email", "name"?, "staff"?}; leaving out staff keeps it. 201 with the reader; 404 {"error":"no such org"}.
Grants or revokes the staff view. Body {"staff": true}. Takes effect on the reader's next request. 200 with the reader; 404 {"error":"no such reader"}. See .
Removes a reader. 204; 404 {"error":"no such reader"}.

refbody.p: Emails are unique without regard to case.

strow.stentry: The latest 100 entries, newest first: at, actor, action and detail.

refbody.p: Actions are repo.upsert, repo.access, build.request, org.upsert, entitlements.set, org.delete, reader.upsert, reader.staff, reader.delete and, from the seed command, seed.apply. The admin console adds settings.oidc, settings.signin, settings.editor, github.connect, github.install, github.disconnect, editor.user, admin.setup-link and admin.setup. Details never hold a secret.

reference.title: Admin console settings and setup links

strow.stentry: The settings stored by the admin console (values), which stored secrets are set (secrets, as "set"; never their values), any that this key cannot decrypt (unreadable), where each group of settings comes from (sources: env, console, broker or none) and the GitHub mode.
A one-time link that makes its visitor the first staff reader. Body {"minutes": 30} (5 to 1440, default 30). 201 {"url", "expiresAt"}; 409 once a staff reader exists. See .
Lists public API keys: id, name, prefix, scopes, audience, orgSlug, creation, expiry, last use and revocation times. Never the token. See .

Creates a key. Body {"name": "Support bot", "scopes": ["read"], "audience": "org", "org": "acme", "expiresInDays": 90}: scopes from read, write, publish, builds; audience staff, org (with org) or public; expiresInDays 1 to 3650, or null for never (default 90). 201 with the key and its token, shown only here.
Revokes a key at once. 204; 404 when there is no such active key.
Totals, views by surface, top pages, top searches, searches with no results, and the share of "helpful" answers per page, least helpful first. enabled says whether recording is on.
Feedback answers, newest first: at, topicId, helpful, comment, surface, orgSlug and releaseLine.
The same list as a CSV download, for a spreadsheet.

property.propdesc: Look back this many days, 1 to 3650.
Rows per list: at most 1000 in the summary, 10000 for feedback.
Only this organization's readers, by slug.
Feedback only: one topic id, such as topics/install.
Feedback only: 1 lists only answers with a comment.

refbody.p: Comments are reader text: the JSON returns them as written, and the CSV quotes every field and prefixes values that start with =, +, - or @ with an apostrophe, so a spreadsheet does not run them as formulas. Escape comments before showing them in any web page of your own.
